modeReason: Two stories clear the relevance threshold of 8: the claim that an AI tool out-diagnoses doctors (novelty 3 x magnitude 2 x breadth 3 = 18), and the datacenter backlash now reaching elections and causing deforestation abroad (2 x 2 x 3 = 12).
phrase: An AI tool claims to diagnose better than doctors. Nearby, towns are fighting data centers over felled forests and drained water.
phraseAlternatives: One AI claims to out-diagnose doctors. The towns near its rivals' data centers are losing trees and water.
A new AI tool says it beats doctors at hard diagnoses. Meanwhile, data centers are draining wells and felling forests nearby.
AI promises sharper diagnoses than doctors give. The land feeding its data centers tells a thirstier story.
An AI system claims to diagnose better than doctors can. Outside its data centers, forests are gone and wells are dry.

brief.concept: A robot doctor proudly holds up a diagnosis chart with a taller bar than a human doctor's, while through a window behind them a small datacenter sits on a hillside of tree stumps beside a dry well.
brief.metaphor: The diagnosis chart rises like a boast; the stumps and the dry well are the quiet bill behind it.

cast.who: a robot doctor in a white coat holding up a diagnosis chart with a tall bar
a human doctor standing beside a shorter bar on the same chart
a datacenter seen through a window, standing on a hillside of tree stumps
a dry well with a small protest sign beside the datacenter

brief.composition: One split scene: in the foreground, a robot doctor and a human doctor stand before a shared bar chart, the robot's bar taller. Through a window behind them, a small datacenter sits on a stump-covered hill beside a dry well with a tiny protest sign. Keep it to these four shapes plus the window frame.
brief.alt: A robot doctor holds up a chart showing a taller bar than the human doctor standing beside it. Through a window behind them, a datacenter sits on a hillside covered in tree stumps next to a dry well with a small protest sign.
